dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = today. History goes back years, so past dates return released actuals.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = From date plus Days ahead. Up to one year per run.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead
daysAhead.description: Used when To date is empty.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Optional, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, NZD, CHF, CNY. Empty = all.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Optional, e.g. United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Japan. Useful to split the euro area by country. Empty = all.

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.description: Indicators have actual/forecast/previous values; speeches are central bankers and officials; holidays are bank holidays.

onlyReleased.title: Only released
onlyReleased.description: Only events that already have an actual value.
